one_liner: Ranks every number by its appearances, each older one counting for less, halving after about 13 draws (a quarter).
registry_status_reason: Released by package REL-1 (releases and WF-1 design v0.1r1, owner decisions WF1-1 and WF1-2, ratified 31 October 2026). Contract runs on real data need the separate real-development gate.
short_explanation: E_9 looks at each number on its own. It adds up every past appearance of each number, with each draw counting 18/19 as much as the one after it, so an appearance loses half its weight after about 13 draws (a quarter). It ranks the numbers by that value: its top pick is the highest-ranked numbers and its inverse pick the lowest-ranked, with exact ties settled by the project tie rule (TIE_SHA256_V1). Its scores are not chances, so no probabilities are published. It uses only which numbers were drawn, not their order or the dates, and needs 1 earlier draw. If the draws are fair, it is not expected to beat chance.
